title: Health Sleep Session Event V1
description: A sleep interval exactly as provided by the origin application through Health Connect. The bounds are reported observations, not inferences: the system never describes device-idle time as sleep and never derives sleep from absence of activity.

end_at.description: Exclusive UTC wake boundary as provided by the origin.

record_id.description: Stable record identifier supplied by Health Connect for the originating record; retained so source record counts reconcile against server acknowledgements.

privacy_level.description: Health observations default to sensitive; credentials need an adequate privacy ceiling to upload or read them.

value.description: Sleep duration in milliseconds, equal to end_at - start_at.

data_origin.description: Package name of the application that wrote the record into Health Connect. Observations from different origins stay distinct; overlapping intervals from another origin never delete this one.

SourceKind.title: Source Kind
SourceKind.description: Health Connect records read by the Android collector. The origin application inside each payload is the data origin; the collector itself is only the transport.
